title: Per-sub-game log artifact
description: The artifact the Replay app reads, and the one rule 20 makes a threshold condition. Every `required` entry is book-mandated: the per-step commit data (State, Move, Intent, Nonce) and its SHA-256 signature at p.34/94 and p.58/146, the sub-game number at p.131/276, the verbal hint at p.35/96, and the mutual agreement at p.131/276 under rule 36. additionalProperties is TRUE -- the book is NOT-SPECIFIED on extra fields in reporting artifacts, and refusing an opponent's log over a key no source forbids would fail the very audit rule 36 requires.

game_uid.description: AR-001: every artifact of one match shares this. Four files that each validate and disagree here describe a match that never happened.

sub_game_number.description: p.131/276. Appendix F table 18 fixes six sub-games in a series.

records.description: One entry per step. A commitment with no revealed payload cannot be checked; a payload with no commitment was never bound to anything.

commit.description: Hcommit -- the SHA-256 over state, move, intent and nonce (p.34/94).

intent.description: p.35/96: whether the hint was truthful. A hint without its intent flag cannot be judged, and rule 22 punishes only the deliberate lie.

nonce.description: Present only after the Final Reveal. Rule 18 keeps the nonce secret UNTIL THE END OF THE GAME (inst/:3354); Step 4 is where all nonces are revealed for the mutual audit (inst/:1136). It is therefore absent mid-game and required in the finished artifact -- which is why it is not in the top-level `required` list but is validated when present.

mutual_agreement.description: Rule 36, p.131/276: the comprehensive mutual audit is a mandatory condition before agreement on the JSON result.
